name: nuxt-bun-compile
description: Nuxt module that automatically configures Nitro for `bun build --compile`, generating a standalone executable binary from your Nuxt app.

scripts.dev:prepare: bunx --bun nuxt-module-build build --stub && bunx --bun nuxt-module-build prepare && bunx --bun nuxt prepare playground
scripts.format: bun run --bun dprint fmt package.json tsconfig.json dprint.json ./src/*.ts ./src/**/*.ts
scripts.test:types: bun run --bun vue-tsc --noEmit && bun run --cwd playground --bun vue-tsc --noEmit
scripts.release: bun prepack && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.prerelease: bun clear;bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun format && bun lint && bun dev:prepare && bun run test
scripts.clear: rm -rf node_modules .nuxt dist package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml nuxt-bun-compile-*.tgz playground/node_modules playground/.nuxt playground/.output playground/nuxtbin test/fixtures/basic/node_modules test/fixtures/basic/.nuxt
